lines.zh: 合体之后，走路都轻飘飘
lines.en: After fusion, even walking feels light.
I glide along, feet barely touching ground.
This vest came with the fusion.
Short legs, but quick steps.

lines.zh: 飞行才是我的赶路方式
lines.en: Flying is how I really travel.

lines.zh: 两个小孩合起来，走路也吵
lines.en: Two kids fused, still noisy walking.

lines.zh: 气在脚下一推，就过去了
lines.en: A push of ki and I'm across.

lines.zh: 我的头发比身高还精神
lines.en: My hair has more spirit than my height.
Walking midair draws stares.
This cloth outfit flutters nicely.
I think up moves while I walk.
So fast, only an afterimage remains.
Thirty minutes? No, I can last longer.
The fusion clock is ticking.
I'm naming a new attack.
Standing still, I still charge ki.
I'm far stronger than I look.

lines.zh: 这具身体是两个人拼的
lines.en: This body is two people stitched together.
That cloud looks like a turtle shell.

lines.zh: 悟天和特兰克斯都在里面
lines.en: Goten and Trunks are both in here.
Saving a big move for later.
Ki circling inside feels good.

lines.zh: 我笑一下，你就该紧张了
lines.en: If I smile, you should worry.
Is this pose cool or what?
Three hundred points of life, plenty to play with.
Don't rush me; I'm working on my line.
Oh? Here comes someone worth fighting.
Your ki's weak, but fine.

lines.zh: 我盯你很久了，别装没看见
lines.en: I've been watching you; don't play blind.

lines.zh: 你的站姿一看就没练过
lines.en: Your stance says you never trained.
I raise a brow and you step back.

lines.zh: 想打还是想聊，我都能陪
lines.en: Fight or chat, I can do both.
At your height, I can almost look level.
Don't worry, I rarely strike first.
I'm smiling because you're amusing.
Your ki is trembling.

lines.zh: 我看人很准，你撑不过三招
lines.en: I read people well: you last three moves.
Come on, give me a name first.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是不是很欠揍
lines.en: Does this face just beg to be punched?
You're here to hand over experience, right?

lines.zh: 再靠近，我就当你挑战了
lines.en: One step closer and I take it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 我懒得认真，除非你值得
lines.en: I won't get serious unless you earn it.
Your ki... has something to it.
I'm counting your openings.
Ow! You actually landed one.
I dodged, still got clipped.
Not heavy, but humiliating.
All right, you're done.
Even fused, I feel pain.
Guess I misread that.
I'll dodge the next one early.

lines.zh: 这身体是借来的，省着用
lines.en: This body's borrowed; I'll be careful.

lines.zh: 你这一下，我记了好多下
lines.en: That one I'll repay many times.

lines.zh: 吃的？合体后胃口也变大了
lines.en: Food? Fusion made me hungrier too.

lines.zh: 你手里那袋，能分我点吗
lines.en: Can you spare some from that bag?
I'm not greedy; I just burn a lot.
Bribing me with snacks?
After the fight I'll eat; remembering that.

lines.zh: 合体状态下吃饭很麻烦
lines.en: Eating while fused is awkward.
I smell it; don't hide it.

lines.zh: 你给我，我就少打你两下
lines.en: Give it here and I'll hit you twice less.
Two stomachs fused into one.
So good; another portion.
Bumped me? You bounced back, didn't you.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我气会外放
lines.en: Don't crowd me; my ki leaks.
I'm airborne; you can't shove me.
A bump counts as a trade.

lines.zh: 小心点，我这身体很结实
lines.en: Careful, this body's tough.
You hit my ki barrier.
Move; I'm practicing footwork.
That wasn't an attack, relax.
You clipped me; noted.
I turned too fast and caught you.
A fused being doesn't talk of partners.

lines.zh: 我有两个人在里面，够了
lines.en: I've got two people in here; enough.
You've got the wrong guy.
First I have to outlast the fusion timer.
When the timer ends, I come apart.
Not so close; our ki would clash.

lines.zh: 我这份热闹，不需要多余的人
lines.en: I'm already noisy enough.
Beat me first, then we'll talk.
My time is expensive.

lines.zh: 先别聊这个，我忙着变强
lines.en: Not now; I'm busy getting stronger.
I'll take what's on the ground.
Bent too fast, nearly tumbled.
This bean? I'll keep it.
I pick things up with ki pull.
Just a small thing; don't grab.
My hands are quicker than yours.

lines.zh: 这些东西算我的战利品
lines.en: Spoils of battle.
Picked up and pocketed.

lines.zh: 地上有东西就想拿，习惯了
lines.en: I grab whatever's on the ground, habit.

lines.zh: 这点分量，一根手指就够
lines.en: This weight takes one finger.
Fine, let's fight.
I'm getting serious; don't regret it.
Charging ki first.
I'm far beyond you in speed.
Close-range combos are my specialty.
Kamehameha, ready.
This isn't a joke now.
Locked on; don't squirm.

lines.zh: 三百点生命，你先扣多少
lines.en: Three hundred points; how much will you shave?

lines.zh: 两个小孩的怒火，合起来不小
lines.en: Two kids' anger, fused, isn't small.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我还你十下
lines.en: Hit me once, I return ten.
Ki gathered in my hands.
I've predicted your first step.
Don't underestimate this small body.
Let's begin; my time is short.
Circling you, hunting an angle.

lines.zh: 你的动作我看得一清二楚
lines.en: I see your every move clearly.
A ki blast to test you.
I won't trade blows; I'll toy with you.

lines.zh: 你往左，我早就到左边了
lines.en: Go left; I'm already left.
Can afterimages fool you?
Waiting for your opening.
Winding up an aerial combo.
The more you rush, the more you open up.
My ki is rising.
This one's a small ki blast; try it.
There's someone behind you too.
My speed is still climbing.
Thirty seconds is enough for you.
Reading your dodge habits.
Don't blink; you'll miss me.
Rapid fire begins.
Charged dash, incoming.
Aerial combo, catch it.
One punch, two, and a third.
My fists hit harder than they look.
This is fusion's power.
Kick first, then a ki blast.
Don't fall yet; I'm not warmed up.
Fifteen a hit, one at a time.
My hits look flashy, and they hurt.
I leap and slam down.
Afterimage fist; you hit air.
The combo isn't over.
I'm sending you skyward.
Finisher. Cool, right?
Fusion complete; I'm here.

lines.zh: 两个小孩拼成了一个我
lines.en: Two kids fused into one me.
Strike the pose first.
I am Gotenks.
My ki flares; everything brightens.

lines.zh: 天神殿那边也该听到我
lines.en: Even Kami's lookout should hear me.
I'm here; don't blink.

lines.zh: 这身背心，是合体的证明
lines.en: This vest proves the fusion.
The countdown has started.

lines.zh: 我比刚才那两个加起来强
lines.en: Stronger than those two combined.

lines.zh: 地上的尘土都被气吹开
lines.en: My ki blows the dust away.
I arrived right on time.
Fight fast; my time is limited.
One push off, and I'm airborne.

lines.zh: 合体失败的姿势我可不想摆
lines.en: I don't want a failed-fusion pose.
I'll settle this round.

lines.zh: 别问我怎么来的，问就是我强
lines.en: Don't ask how I got here; I'm just strong.
Remember the name: Gotenks.
Hot! I jumped clear.
After that fall, half my ki scattered.
I can't swim! Really, I can't.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪推着我去撞墙
lines.en: The blast wave threw me into a wall.

lines.zh: 小东西扎破气罩，扎进我手臂。
lines.en: Something small pierced my aura and sank into my arm.
This strange energy isn't ki.
Too hungry to raise my ki.

lines.zh: 雷打在身上，头发都炸了
lines.en: Lightning struck; even my hair crackled.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我掉下去了
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; I'm falling.
